semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Jinyuan Semi Technology specializes in manufacturing components and consumables for the semiconductor industry, contributing to the supply chain.
summary: Jinyuan Semi Technology (Wuxi) Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of semiconductor equipment consumables, including customized sealing parts, heaters, and shower heads. The company leverages advanced technology from Japan and South Korea to enhance the semiconductor materials and parts supply chain both in China and globally.

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Wuxi, China, with factories in Wuxi and Hefei.
